messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty triggered — PD-2026-042 — latency p99 exceeded threshold (2.8s > 2.0s). Auto-page to rotation.

pagerduty: PD-2026-042 fired: escalation to rotation Jordan. Please ack and triage.

jordan: Acked. I'm on it — looking at quick dashboards now. Anyone see a recent deploy?

sam: Ack @jordan. Looking at routing and kv-cache metrics. Tail spike started ~12:36UTC.

anya: Seeing a big burst from customer "acme-integration" at 12:35 — request rate ~4x baseline. Grafana: https://grafana/redwood/d/latency (short link).

matt: Autoscaler near capacity (pods ~95%). Also a model rollout 'gptx-quant-v2' finished ~12:20. Could be slow under burst.

jordan: Can we pin traffic for /api/v1/generate to fallback model gptx-quant-v1 for the affected routes?

sam: Doing a temporary route override now.

sam: ```
rdctl route override set --path /api/v1/generate --model gptx-quant-v1 --duration 10m
```

incident-bot: Action logged — route override applied by sam. PagerDuty note appended.

matt: Manually scaling inference pool +4 GPUs now to buy headroom.

matt: ```
kubectl scale deployment/inference-pool --replicas=12 -n redwood-prod
```

anya: KV cache eviction spike at 12:37, warmup in progress. Expect p99 to drop after warming (~5-7m).

sam: After override + scale, p99 on canary is 1.9s; global p99 ~2.1s and trending down. Customer-impact estimate: ~1.8% of requests > 2s during the window.

jordan: Noted. Who did the gptx-quant-v2 rollout? We should consider rollback if metrics don't stabilize.

matt: Rollout from infra-ci at 12:20. Opening rollback now and tagging release-bot.

matt: Rollback initiated.

pagerduty: PD-2026-042 status -> acknowledged / identifying cause. Please post an impact summary for the incident update.

sam: Impact summary: 12:36–12:44UTC p99 peaked 2.8s. ~1.8% of requests affected. No upstream 5xx spike. Root cause likely: new quantized model variant performs worse under burst + cold KV behavior.

anya: Support notified top-5 customers; ACME flagged for priority follow-up.

jordan: Handoff: @sam monitors next 30m; I'll write rotation notes and SLO blurb. @matt continue rollback + verify.

matt: Rollback complete, verification checks green.

sam: Monitoring window — next 10m. p99 steady 1.6–2.0s, no new pages.

pagerduty: PD-2026-042 marked resolved by matt. Closing note: route override + scale + rollback mitigated the issue. Follow-up: postmortem and rollout gating for model quant variants.

jordan: Thanks team :thumbsup: I'll file a short postmortem and add a gating checklist for future model rollouts (perf + burst testing).

sam: Added runbook note: pre-warm KV cache and run burst perf tests for quantized variants. We'll schedule follow-up with release and infra teams.
